summary: Build practical HR compliance skills with labor risk registers, ILO principles, ISO 37301 controls, and workforce reporting. Enrol today.
lede: Labour market regulations training helps HR professionals translate employment requirements into consistent policies, controls, and records. It is for HR business partners, employee relations specialists, people operations managers, and compliance staff who need to monitor obligations and support defensible decisions. Participants practise building a compliance register, mapping employment lifecycle controls, assessing policy and working-time risks, and reviewing workforce indicators and investigation evidence.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who interpret, implement, monitor, or report labour market regulations through HR policies and workforce processes.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of core HR processes such as recruitment, onboarding, employee relations, performance management, payroll coordination, or workforce reporting is recommended. You do not need legal qualifications or programming skills. Bring examples of non-confidential HR policies, process maps, or workforce reports if available for contextual exercises.
